summary: Tested lembrete-pagamento feed event, email link origem params, and email-click tracking on pagamento-pix. All requested features work end-to-end. Backend 4/4 pytest passed; UI flows passed. The preview Resend API key returns 401 'API key is invalid', so here the job finished with enviados=0, falhas=1 and the event read 'Lembrete de pagamento enviado para 0 inscrito(s) (1 falha(s))'. This is an environment problem, not a code bug.

minor.issue: RESEND_API_KEY in preview /app/backend/.env is rejected (401 API key is invalid). Real delivery could not be verified here. The user says production delivers.

email_click is inserted on every load that has origem=lembrete|email and skips the sessionStorage/visitor dedupe. If localStorage already holds data for the same CPF, there is no redirect, so the URL keeps ?cpf&origem and each refresh logs another email_click.
Sends to every finalized inscription with an email. There is no paid/unpaid concept, so paid candidates would also get the 'pendente' reminder. This is acceptable only if payment is never tracked.

issues: The 'lembrete_pagamento' and 'email_click' events fall back to the same generic icon/color as 'access' events. Add distinct icon entries (for example a mail icon) to make them stand out.
pix_generated fires on every pagamento-pix load (46 PIX vs 2 inscrições), so the funnel shows 2300% (pre-existing).

action_items: Optional: dedupe email_click per cpf+origem (for example 1 per 30 min), or strip ?cpf&origem with history.replaceState when no hydration redirect happens
Optional: add icon/label mappings for 'lembrete_pagamento' and 'email_click' in the admin feed
Note to user: the preview Resend key is invalid; production key works per the user
critical_code_review_comments: track_access inserts the email_click event before the duplicate-visit check, so it is never deduped
_run_lembrete correctly inserts the event on both success and exception paths
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_LEMBRETE (random CPF, cargo 1) and TEST_UI (CPF 52998224725, cargo 2) inscriptions with delivered@resend.dev; deleted both, along with their events. During the lembrete run the existing record 05669169085 (darkemail) was temporarily set finalized=false so it got no email, then restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest tests/test_lembrete_events.py -n 0 (pytest.ini adds xdist; -n 0 keeps module order). Feed endpoint: GET /api/admin/dashboard/realtime. Verified: fresh context /pagamento-pix.html?cpf=X&origem=lembrete -> track/access with origem+cpf -> resumo hydration -> redirect -> Pix + QR generated (R$150,00 for cargo 2); regression without cpf works; the only console error is the Cloudflare beacon CSP block (harmless).
